headline: Saudi Investment Minister Highlights Fiscal 2027 Budget Priorities
summary: Saudi Investment Minister Fahad Al-Saif announced that the 2027 state budget supports Vision 2030 targets by expanding private sector economic contribution and non-oil growth.
why: Saudi Arabia is OPEC's largest oil exporter, and state budget allocations define investment trends across domestic energy, tourism, and infrastructure projects.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Targeted fiscal expenditure drives non-oil GDP diversification efforts.
